name: TATE + LYLE  LS-,25
summary: Tate & Lyle is a global provider of food and beverage ingredients and solutions. The company operates through two divisions: Food & Beverage Solutions and Primary Products, providing ingredients such as sweeteners, starches, and fibers to enhance taste, texture, and nutrition in food and beverages. Tate & Lyle is headquartered in London, United Kingdom.
